text_block_list.text:
After realizing how Nishino Flower had changed.
To plan out our upcoming training, I had been re-evaluating her current running style, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry,
I didn't run very well...

She was bothered by the fact that her time had dropped compared to before.
However, that was only natural, because—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it...
I have an image in mind of how I actually want to move, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, my legs just stepped forward on their own, completely out of sync with what I was imagining...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Can you feel it?

A disconnect must have formed between the sensations
she's honed and her actual body.
Still, that's nothing to be disheartened about.
choice_data_list: Physical growth will definitely become a weapon.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so...?
choice_data_list: If we overcome this, we'll become even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
You're right...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll do my best to master this new running style...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer was so kind.
But I can't just keep relying on their pampering forever.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I can get stronger... Yeah, I'm sure of it.
Alright, I'll do my best to overcome this—)

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: —Hmm, there are some tricky aspects to it as well, aren't there.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh? Is that Teacher's and...
Trainer's voices?)

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
True, a larger body increases muscle mass,
which leads to improved abilities. However...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
The "sense" of how to use one's body is a particularly
delicate matter for athletes. It's true that some girls cannot
adapt to changes and become unable to show their true abilities.
(*pitter-patter...*)

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ..."Running in the halls is mandatory", was it?
I still haven't gotten used to this school rule.
Anyway, regarding the concerns I mentioned...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Basically, it's a very positive development.
Keep a close eye on Nishino Flower during training, and do your best as a team.

When it comes to intuitive feel, we have no choice but to rely on her own efforts.
However, I can support those efforts.
In that case—
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear your thoughts on the menu.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(What if... I can't do it right?
Far from improving on who I was before...
I might just ruin everything.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Can I really do it...?
Little flower... what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (The flowerbed I made because I wanted to show Trainer... I've secretly planted all kinds of flowers there, but...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh dear, the cinerarias...
Did the frost get to them...?”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Please don't wither away any further.
It will only make me sadder."
(Prrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Trainer-san.
...Heading to the trainer's office?
(Drip...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?
Huh, was rain in the forecast today?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...They said if it gets too bad,
the roots start to rot.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Every time I run in a race, I'll plant more flowers.
Someday, when the flowerbed is full,
I want to show it to you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We don't want them to wither away
any more than this... do we?
(Shaaaaa...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, hello.
Um, what did you want to talk about...?

What I handed to Nishino Flower was a training menu redesigned to match her growth.
And not just that...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? They're labeled with things like
"A" and "B", though...
choice_data_list: I made a few variations so we can switch them up on the fly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...!
"I put this together by asking girls who, like her, grew larger after hitting their growth phase,as well as gathering input from their Trainers."

Of course, at this point, it's merely a prediction.
I just wanted to show her that no matter what changes occur, we can adapt immediately.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Did you really put this much thought into it in such a short amount of time...?"
If it were before I met Nishino Flower, it might have been difficult. But having run this far together with her—
choice_data_list: You're the one who helped me grow.
It's because you helped me grow.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: I did say 'once we get past this', but...

text_block_list.text:
Before, I lacked the confidence to say it.
But now, I know I can support and guide her.
choice_data_list: With the two of you, everything will be fine!
With the two of you, everything will be fine!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe,
you really are a wonderful Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When Trainer is working this hard for me...
hanging my head would just ruin everything.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was acting like a bit of a scaredy-cat.
But... I'm all right now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll surpass the old me!
Together with you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

After renewing our determination and
discussing our future plans together...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san?!
What on earth is with that outfit...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was taking a nap,
and I didn't even notice for a while.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah!?
I-It's pouring...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh no! The flower bed is...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, looks like that's going to be fine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I happened to walk by, and it looks like some kind soul
covered it with a blue tarp and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *Haa*, thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who it was?
I'd love to thank them someday.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll go take a look just in case!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even though I told her I was fine.
...Well, I guess having lots of energy is a good thing~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wonder what that's about.
